theorems.name: Submission.idod_spine_invariant_density_nat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (θ₀ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → n ≤ Module.finrank ℝ L + 2 → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → HasMassDensity S 0 θ₀ → ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ = m
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
